main_text.head: VATICINII IMPLEMENTUM DEMONSTRATUM.
main_text.p: NOtandum interim Prophetam hic loqui, ac si jam tum adessent, quae præ foribus erant; quia in visione prophetica illi dabatur intueri secutura, ac si inspiceret coram, dum videbat ea in divino repræsentamine oblata. Proin, quid secutum fuerit ex historiâ recensendum est, ut visionis cum e-ventu constet analogia.

I. Inspiciamus regis Chaldæorum conatus: & occurret 1. plusquam una expeditio, quarum prior imaginem refert piscaturæ, hamo inescantis gentes. Id factum, quan-do Ægyptio in terras suas repulso, cæteras nationes in fœdus recepit, ut penso tributo ejus imperium,agnoscant: ita in initio arte eas allexit, dum eas clementer habuit, & potentioris defensionis oblatione inescavit. Altera vero ex-peditio speciem habuit piscaturæ, fagenâ populos attrahentis, ex quibus novas fecit colonias: quale quid factum, cum Jechoniam[?] regem, cum matre, regni proceribus, populique flore, Babyloniam abduxit, tenuioribus tantum ex plebe infimi Hierosolymis relictis, quorum aut ætas victori fastidio erat, aut imbecillitas servitio inutilis solum exercendis colendisque agris videbatur. Hac fagenâ evacuatâ tertia secuta est expeditio, quando piscaturam repetens quasi everriculo terram Judaicam

page.notes: Initial N is a large woodcut letter, joined to "Notandum" as "NOtandum". The numeral "1." after "occurret" is set in the text line, so it is kept as printed. "Jechoniam" is doubtful: the scan is unclear and it may read differently. The text ends mid-sentence at the foot of the page, as printed. Printed "imperium,agnoscant" lacks a space after the comma, which is kept as printed.
